# HOUSING AND LODGING Every registered colonist is entitled to a bunk in a residential block. Families may apply for a shared unit through administration.
## RULES OF THE BLOCK - Keep corridors and hatches clear at all times. - No open flames, cooking plates or modified heaters in sleeping quarters. - Pets must be registered with the colony medical office. - Noise after 2300 colony time will be reported.
## MAINTENANCE REQUESTS Lighting, plumbing and door faults are handled in the order they are received. Emergency faults take priority.
